desc:
🩸 Ragdoll X-Ray Reality 🩸

See every hit in X-ray! Smash, launch and blast crash-test dolls across a huge sandbox world. Land a perfect shot and watch it in slow motion, right through to the bones.

🦴 X-RAY CAM: broken arms, cracked skulls and flying limbs, live in slow-motion X-ray.
💥 25+ WEAPONS: fists, bats, katanas, pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, a gravity gun and more. Every broken doll counts towards your next unlock.
🚜 VEHICLES: drive the lawn mower, the combine harvester or a real tank straight through the crowd.
🗺️ EXPLORE: Doll Town, the sawmill, the medieval village, the zoo and the secret military base.
🌙 FUN ITEMS: the Moon Gun makes everything float, or become a giant and stomp around.
👫 PLAY WITH FRIENDS: invite your friends to your own server and troll each other with jail cages, ragdoll guns and PvP mode.
🎁 DAILY & PLAYTIME REWARDS: come back every day for free kills and exclusive weapons.
❓ Something mysterious unlocks at 10,000 kills...
